description: Generate the layout foundation the other generators leave out: breakpoints (with what changes at each), container max-widths, edge padding, a column grid, an intrinsic auto-fit card grid, container queries, and a fluid section-rhythm scale — as CSS custom properties and a Tailwind v4 @theme block, plus the rules that matter more than the numbers (design narrow-first, cap the measure at 45–75ch, prefer intrinsic layout to media queries). Deterministic real code. Pair with generate_type_scale and generate_design_tokens.

container_queries.description: Include a container-query example so components respond to their own width (default true)

gutter.description: Gutter between columns in px (default 16–32 by preset)

max_width.description: Max content width in px (default depends on preset: 960–1440)

preset.description: Layout archetype (default 'marketing-site'): 'web-app' for a dense app shell with a sidebar, 'docs' for a three-zone documentation layout, 'mobile-first' for a 4→12 column phone-first grid

name: generate_layout_system
title: Generate Layout System
